summary: Iteration 2 — added new /app/backend/tests/test_challenges.py covering the vocal CHALLENGES module (catalog, attempt creation for all 7 types, validation errors, list/audio/delete with ownership). Re-ran full backend suite: 50/50 tests passed (28 existing regression + 22 new challenge tests). All 7 challenge types exercised: sustained_vowel, mpt (8s sine → mpt_seconds≈8s and grade in {alert,warn}), ddk_pataka, glissando (100→400Hz sweep → range_semitones between 20-26 and f0_min≈100 / f0_max≈400), loudness_range, sz_ratio, reading. Ownership isolation verified with second doctor session. Storage-file deletion confirmed on disk. Regression on CORS + voice/upload + auth + reports SSE still green.

minor.issue: When a different doctor posts an attempt for a patient they don't own, the endpoint returns 404 ('Patient not found') because the ownership filter is applied at the Mongo query (owner_user_id + patient_id). Behavior is safe (no data leak) but semantically closer to 403 for role=doctor. Cosmetic only.

For role=patient, ownership is not enforced — a linked patient can access any attempt whose linked_user_id chain resolves. Current filter only blocks role=doctor whose id differs. If patients ever get direct access, add explicit patient-side check. Non-blocking for MVP (patient role currently has no UI for challenges).

Only checks owner_user_id vs current user; a secretary role would get 403, which is fine, but role check is implicit rather than explicit. Consider `if user.role != 'doctor' or doc['owner_user_id'] != user.user_id: 403` for defense in depth.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: return 403 (instead of 404) when non-owner doctor posts a challenge attempt for another doctor's patient, for consistency with voice_analysis delete/report semantics.
Optional: add explicit `user.role == 'doctor'` check to delete_challenge_attempt and challenge_audio for defense-in-depth (currently only owner_user_id check).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1300 lines with 13 concerns — the earlier recommendation to split into routers (voice_router.py, challenges_router.py, ...) is more urgent. HIGH.

voice_analysis.analyze_challenge duplicates ffmpeg conversion logic already in analyze_audio; both call _to_wav independently. If both endpoints hit the same upload later (unlikely), the file gets converted twice. Minor perf note.

analyze_challenge builds the `evaluation` object via if/elif on challenge_type with copy-pasted grade thresholds — extract to a small `_evaluate_{challenge}` helper table for maintainability. Currently ~150 lines of nested branches.

sz_ratio implementation assumes the /s/ and /z/ each occupy exactly the first and second half of the recording. That is a strong assumption not stated in the challenge instruction ('Envie os dois áudios (ou um após o outro)'). Consider a silence-based split (parselmouth `To TextGrid (silences)`) for real recordings; current impl is only a rough proxy. Report to product/UX.

_syllable_count is a simplified peak-picker with hard-coded thresholds (-25 dB / 2 dB dip). Real DDK from a sustained sine returns spurious peaks — noted, and the endpoint returns without crashing per spec. Consider disabling `_syllable_count` when signal has near-zero jitter (i.e., synthetic).

challenge_audio + delete_challenge_attempt do NOT check `user.role`; they only compare owner_user_id. If a `secretary` role ever gets a session token, they'd get 403 correctly (owner_id doesn't match), but the semantics rely on `owner_user_id` being unique. Add explicit role guard for defense-in-depth.

CHALLENGE_CATALOG is a module-level dict returned via `list(CHALLENGE_CATALOG.values())` — dict insertion order preserves the 7 items, but if Python semantics ever change this becomes flaky. Consider an explicit ordered list.
storage.LocalStorage.delete is now confirmed to use `missing_ok=True` (fix from iteration 1 addressed).
No pagination on /api/voice/challenges/attempts — .to_list(300) hard cap. Fine for MVP, needs pagination once patients have >300 attempts.
test_credentials: Doctor: Authorization: Bearer test_session_doctor_001 (user_id=user_test_doctor_001). Other doctor for ownership: test_session_other_002. Patient: pat_test_001. Seed via `python /app/backend/tests/seed_data.py` (idempotent).
seed_data_creation: Reused /app/backend/tests/seed_data.py from iteration 1 (idempotent upserts). No new seed required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two test files now under /app/backend/tests: backend_test.py (iteration 1: CORS + voice_analysis + regression) and test_challenges.py (iteration 2: vocal challenges). Both parallelizable via pytest-xdist LoadScope. Run either individually or `pytest backend/tests/ --junitxml=...`. Sine-wave-based synthetic audio via numpy+wave (see _sine_wav / _sweep_wav helpers). All 7 challenge types verified: MPT 8s → grade in {alert,warn} and mpt_seconds in 7-8.5; Glissando 100→400Hz over 5s → range_semitones 20-26, f0_min 80-130, f0_max 350-450. ffmpeg is present at /usr/bin/ffmpeg.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Two failing test-runs during authoring were due to (a) xdist LoadScope splitting classes across workers so module-level `_created_attempts` list wasn't shared; refactored each ownership/delete/audio test to create its own attempt in-line. (b) `test_list_owner_only` ran on a worker that had no prior attempts yet — added an inline create before assertion. Both are test-side issues, not app issues.
